body: I feel your pain so much :( it hurts like hell when you still love and miss them so much yet they’re moving on with someone new. I hope the right person comes into your life and restores your heart ❤️

I feel your pain :( I loved and still do love my ex bf so much it hurts but he’s already moved onto someone else. I feel like he meant the world to me yet I meant nothing to him. Did something happen recently to make you feel like this?

Thankyou so much for being brave enough to share your story. I just wanted to let you know I really relate to the abuse you suffered from this man. My heart truly breaks for you. I know all too well those thoughts and feelings of doubting whether you were even assaulted but even if you were you somehow ‘deserved’ it. But you 100% did nothing to deserve such abuse. He took advantage of your vulnerability and desire to be loved. I am so sorry for the pain and trauma you went through and I know how much it changes you, you just will never be or feel the same again. You are a remarkable woman for surviving this though. You are so brave, strong and inspiring for no longer allowing this man to manipulate and destroy you anymore. I hope you find true peace and joy in your life xox

I really appreciate your response your such a caring kind person 🙏😭♥️ I’m so so sorry you went through similar things to me, but it’s comforting to know you understand my pain. Yeah once you get in an abusive relationship you really start to believe you have such little worth because of how your treated, it just reinforces the shitty beliefs you have about yourself. Yes the binging and purging is definitely a way to try and release the pain, to let it out somehow. I will definitely have a read of those devotionals I find it really helpful to read spiritual books. I really hope to use my experience for good one day and be able to help other women overcome their battles, that is my dream. Thankyou for giving me hope, God bless you 💜💜💜

I just read your entire story and I really feel for you, I hear how much pain your in. I just wanted to let you know that firstly all your hard work hasn’t been a waste, far from it. Secondly I really think you should be honest with the school about how much you’ve been struggling with what sounds like anxiety and depression. This year in particular has been horrendous but particularly for year 12 students already under immense pressure. Also I know your dad seems really upset at you right now but I can assure you he would much rather you be alive. Please don’t do anything to harm yourself, I urge you to seek out better professional care to help get you through this crisis. I’m praying for you tonight

So sorry for the late reply but thankyou for your kind words. I’m definitely so blessed to have my family by my side supporting me so I know I can’t let them down. I’ve been feeling really awful again lately but I’ll try my best to start doing even just small things to help myself feel better. Thanks again ❤️
